name: 定制贴合前挡遮阳档款
description: 双片可重叠适配多车型，隔热防晒降温，折叠收纳附袋好存放

styleLock.direction: custom-fit auto accessory suite: directory-white product truth, pain-collage to diagram persuasion, dusk poster structure highlights, navy-orange claim system
styleLock.temperature: neutral-cool on white grounds; warm daylight allowed in pain photos; dusk warmth confined to structure posters
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for hero and variant; light blue-gray gradient panel #C7D7ED to #E9F0F8 for pain-and-solution frames; light gray-white diagonal texture #F3F4F6 for spec frames; dark desert or track environments only for structure posters
styleLock.lightingSystem: softbox frontal or top light with no hard shadows for product; backlight daylight through the windshield for cabin shots; low-angle dusk key with rim light for posters
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte reflective polyester white face #EDEFF0 and black coated face #26292D with bright black binding; matte environments only - asphalt, sand, dashboard - never mirror tables
styleLock.typography: heavy italic condensed uppercase headlines; navy pill banners carry claims with orange keyword highlight blocks; white type on navy bands
styleLock.iconSystem: round certification-style badges, dimension lines with dot terminals, thermometer and glow diagram for heat, circular magnifier insets, size-pill labels
styleLock.presentationRules: hero stacks flat-lay above fitted car; variant frames always pair the folded shade above with the fitted vehicle below plus a size label; pain frames use three real-life tiles resolving into one diagram; performance numbers shown only when verified
noDrift: product geometry fixed to its fold states
no fabricated patents, certifications or lab marks
no unauthorized vehicle brand badges or recognizable plates
brand accents locked to orange on navy
background never becomes a saturated gradient
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: custom-fit windshield sunshade campaign. Clean white-studio hero with the flat-lay shade stacked above a fitted generic sedan; directory-style variant frames pair the folded shade with each vehicle class and a navy size pill; a three-tile real-life pain collage (heat, aging interior, sweating cabin) resolves into a coated-fabric heat-refraction diagram on a light blue panel #C7D7ED to #E9F0F8; dark desert-dusk posters highlight structural cutouts with rim light; navy #1F3D6D pill banners with orange #F5A11C keyword highlights carry every size and material claim, all performance numbers from verified facts. Softbox product light, windshield backlight in cabins, low dusk key in posters; matte polyester faces #EDEFF0 and #26292D, orange locked on navy, no third-party badges or vehicle logos.

shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. provenance.notes: 源自约 12.6 万评级的遮阳档 listing；剥离品牌 logo 与车牌位品牌牌、车型适配大表格、跨品应急启动电源广告、宝马/沃尔沃/奔驰等真实车标、真人面孔、SGS 与专利印章（改 proof 占位）、99.9% UV 数值（改 proof 占位）；27 张同构尺寸变体合并为一个母版分镜
